HCl, but does not form  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">M</mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">n</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn><mo>+</mo></mrow></msup></math>  ions

<math><mi mathvariant="normal">M</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">n</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math>  oxidizes hot concentrated  <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn></mrow></msub></math>  liberating oxygen

<math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">K</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">M</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">n</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn></mrow></msub></math>  is formed, when  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">M</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">n</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math>  is fused KOH is oxidized by air,  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">K</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">P</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">b</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math>  or  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">B</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">i</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub></math>

Decomposition of acidic <math><mi mathvariant="normal">K</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">M</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">n</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn></mrow></msub></math> is not catalysed by sunlight

solution.text:
Decomposition of acidic KMnO4 is catalysed by sunlight.

4MnO4-+4H+→4MnO2+3O2+2H2O

A. On dissolution, MnO2 forms Mn2+ ions and HCl is oxidized to Cl2 .

MnO2+4HCl-→Mn2++2Cl-+Cl2+H2O

B. H2SO4 is oxidized by MnO2

2MnO2+2H2SO4→2MnSO4+O2+2H2O

C. MnO2+2KOH+12O2→K2MnO4Green+H2O
